candidates.title: [Performance]: Long-prefill decode starvation survives prefill/decode interleaving — head-to-head from two stacks on 2× GB10, plus a 4×98k-prefill OOM boundary
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  We run DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (MoE + sparse MLA) on a **2× DGX Spark GB10 pair** (TP=2 over a 200 Gb RoCE fabric, one 128 GB unified-memory node per rank) as a small-office shared service. Long-document ingestion (one user pastes a 100k-token document) repeatedly starves concurrent short chat requests.  We already reported the raw phenomenon and the `--prefill-schedule-interval` mitigation in #54919 (that fix works for the *Qwen* model we tested: 1.2 → 22.6 tok/s on the short stream)

The runner dies with `ggml_vulkan: device lost on Vulkan0` right after the model tensors are uploaded, and the API returns HTTP 500 with `exit status 0xe06d7363`.
